title: Static Imports and Dynamic Includes
objective: Choose reuse mechanisms based on parse-time or runtime behavior.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: import_tasks and import_playbook are static: Ansible expands them while parsing. This makes their tasks visible to list operations and applies conditions differently.
include_tasks is dynamic and resolves during execution, which supports runtime-selected files and loops. Use either mechanism to create coherent boundaries rather than hiding control flow.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Choose reuse mechanisms based on parse-time or runtime behavior.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:

  predictable_structure: import_tasks
  runtime_selection: include_tasks
  whole_playbook: import_playbook
